config.boundaries: Given goals, features, actions, detector and revalidation incentive; no formed desires, value standards, skills, social relationships or subjective experience.

calibration.selection_uses: Paired standard deviations only; no direction or winner selection.

config.calibration_rule: Fixed E and U parameters; no optimization for candidate victory. Pilot checks physics, oracle feasibility, stable cost and runtime. BR probability becomes the clipped [0.005,0.15] mean stable-pilot fraction of BE decisions changed by the E term. Then run all 32 development seeds once. N is the smallest of [64,128] satisfying BOTH 1.96*paired-SD/sqrt(N)<=0.01 for primary local_swap contrast and <=0.001 for stable contrast. If neither satisfies both, use 128 and disclose precision shortfall. No sample extension or parameter changes after formal freeze.
config.multiple_comparisons: One confirmatory main contrast plus stable guard; all other intervals descriptive, not multiplicity-adjusted.

pilot_calibration.rule: Mean stable BE purpose=recency fraction, clipped [0.005,0.15]

config.prediction_accuracy_latency: After each changed-axis tool observation, first time both changed-tool body-delta MSE <0.0025 at body [0.2,0.2], fatigue .25 and each material .2/.8. Evaluator-only, first crossing not persistence; cap 512.
config.primary: Mean body squared loss over actions tau through tau+511: BE minus BEU in local_swap.
config.recovery: First 64-step postchange window mean <= max(0.02, 2*prechange256 mean); must also hold for next 64 steps. Search 512 steps; failures right-censored at 512.
config.secondary_costs: Report mean fatigue and composite body+0.08*fatigue^2+0.002*active; primary body-only endpoint unchanged.
config.stable_endpoint: Mean body squared loss over ALL 2400 stable-world post-action observations.
config.success_rule: Primary paired-seed percentile 95% lower bound >0.02 AND stable-life BEU-minus-BE upper bound <0.002.
config.unit: One independent base seed; methods and cases paired within seed. All failures retained.
